source_text: Once upon a time, a young farmer worked in the hills.
translated_text: Hĩndĩ ĩmwe, warĩ na mũrĩmi warĩ na wĩra wa kũruta wĩra tũrĩma-inĩ.

source_text: He loved to tell stories to his family every evening.
translated_text: Nĩ eendete kũheana ngathĩti cia kũigana kũrĩ andũ a famĩlĩ yake o hwaĩ-inĩ.
